entries.title: Spotify Premium benefits
questions: What do I get with Premium?
Why should I buy Spotify Premium?
entries.answer: Spotify Premium includes ad-free music, offline music downloads, on-demand playback and high audio quality. Eligible Premium users can download up to 10,000 tracks on each of up to 5 devices. Feature and audiobook availability can vary by plan and market.

entries.title: Cancel a Premium plan
questions: How do I cancel Spotify Premium?
Will I lose my playlists after canceling?
entries.answer: Open your Spotify account page, go to Manage your plan, and select Cancel subscription. Premium remains active until the next billing date, then the account changes to Spotify Free. Your playlists and saved music remain. If a partner company manages the plan, cancel through that partner.

entries.title: Premium Family
questions: How many people can join Family?
entries.answer: Premium Family covers up to 6 family members who live together, including the manager. Each person uses a separate Spotify account. The manager pays and can add or remove members. Joining members must enter the same home address as the manager.

entries.title: Premium Duo
entries.answer: Premium Duo is for two people who live together. Each member keeps an individual account, saved music and recommendations. The plan manager pays and invites the other eligible household member.

entries.title: Premium Student eligibility
questions: How do I get the Spotify student discount?
entries.answer: Eligible college or university students can receive Premium Student for up to 4 years. Eligibility is verified by SheerID and must be renewed every 12 months. Available payment methods and bundled benefits depend on location.

entries.title: Spotify Basic plans
entries.answer: Basic plans are monthly plans offered to eligible existing Premium subscribers. They include core music benefits such as ad-free listening and offline downloads but do not include monthly audiobook listening time. If canceled, a Basic plan may not be available again.

entries.title: Listen offline
questions: How many songs can I download?
entries.answer: Premium users can download albums, playlists and podcasts; Spotify Free users can download podcasts. You can download up to 10,000 tracks on each of up to 5 devices. Go online at least once every 30 days to keep downloads. Reinstalling the app removes downloaded content from that device.

entries.title: Audio quality settings
questions: How do I change audio quality?
entries.answer: Change quality under Settings and privacy, then Audio Quality or Media Quality. Higher streaming quality uses more data and higher download quality uses more storage. The web player uses AAC 128 kbit/s on Free and AAC 256 kbit/s on Premium; app options depend on plan and device.

entries.title: Lossless audio
entries.answer: Eligible Premium users can select Lossless under Media Quality for Wi-Fi, cellular streaming or downloads, with supported content up to 24-bit/44.1 kHz FLAC. Device compatibility, connection method and network quality affect playback; Bluetooth may not preserve lossless quality.

entries.title: Spotify says it is offline
entries.answer: Check whether Offline mode is enabled, then test other apps or web pages. Restart Wi-Fi or the router, try another network, confirm mobile data allowance, and check firewall settings. If the problem continues, update or reinstall Spotify.

entries.title: Spotify is not playing
entries.answer: Restart the Spotify app, update it, confirm a stable internet connection, close other apps, and verify the device has enough storage. If needed, sign out and back in or reinstall the app. Reinstalling means downloaded content must be downloaded again.

entries.title: No sound on Spotify
entries.answer: Check Spotify and device volume, confirm the correct audio output, and make sure media is not paused on another connected device. Restart the app and device. For Bluetooth or Spotify Connect, disconnect and reconnect the target device.

entries.title: Spotify storage and cache
questions: How do I clear Spotify cache?
entries.answer: Spotify uses storage for cached media and offline downloads and recommends at least 1 GB free. On mobile, go to Settings and privacy, Data-saving and offline, then Storage to clear cache or remove downloads. Android can use an available SD card; desktop users can clear or relocate cache in Settings.

entries.title: Reduce mobile data usage
questions: How can Spotify use less data?
entries.answer: In the mobile app, open Settings and privacy, then Data-saving and offline, and enable Data Saver. You can also lower media quality, disable downloads over cellular, use audio-only video podcasts, turn off Autoplay and use Wi-Fi when possible.

entries.title: Cannot log in
entries.answer: Use Spotify password reset. If you do not remember the account email or username, try possible email addresses; reset email is sent only for a registered address. Also try the login method used at signup, such as phone number, Apple or Google.

entries.title: Reset or change a password
questions: How do I reset my password?
How do I change Spotify password?
entries.answer: Use Spotify's password reset page and enter the email address or username linked to the account. Follow the email link to choose a new password. If the account uses an external login provider, review that provider's login method as well.

entries.title: Protect a compromised account
questions: How do I sign out everywhere?
entries.answer: Change to a strong unique password, then use Sign out everywhere under Security and privacy on your account page. Remove access for unknown third-party apps. Partner devices such as speakers, consoles and TVs may require removing access separately from the apps page.

entries.title: Close an account and delete data
questions: How do I delete my Spotify account?
entries.answer: Use the Close account and delete data flow in Spotify Support while signed in. Premium subscribers generally need to cancel Premium first. Closing an account removes access to playlists and saved content, so review the on-screen consequences before confirming.

entries.title: Failed Premium payment
entries.answer: Confirm that the payment method has sufficient funds, is enabled for online and recurring purchases, and is registered in the same country as the Spotify account. Retry in a private browser window or use another supported payment method. Banks or payment providers may need to authorize the charge.

entries.title: Charged but do not use Premium
questions: I do not recognize a Spotify charge
entries.answer: Check whether Premium is active on another Spotify account by trying other login details or password reset with your email addresses. Also ask family members and check whether a partner provider bills the plan. If the charge remains unknown, contact Spotify Support through the official contact page.

entries.title: Change payment details
questions: How do I update my card?
entries.answer: Sign in to the Spotify account page, open Manage your plan, and update the payment method. Changes normally apply from the next billing date. If a partner such as a phone or internet provider manages the subscription, update payment through that partner.

entries.title: Playlist privacy and profile visibility
questions: How do I make a playlist private?
entries.answer: Open the playlist menu and select Make private. A private playlist cannot be accessed by others, even with a link. Public playlists can be shown on your profile; profile publishing controls are available under Privacy and social settings.

entries.title: Recover a deleted playlist
questions: How can I restore a playlist?
entries.answer: Sign in to your Spotify account page and open Recover playlists. Select Restore beside the deleted playlist, then open Spotify and find it at the bottom of your playlist collection. Recently deleted playlists are recoverable for a limited period shown by Spotify.

entries.title: Collaborative playlists
questions: How do I make a collaborative playlist?
entries.answer: From a playlist you created, use the invite collaborator option and share the generated link. Invited collaborators can add, remove and reorder tracks. Manage access from the playlist menu and remove collaborators you no longer want to participate.

entries.title: Spotify Connect
questions: How do I play Spotify on a speaker?
entries.answer: Spotify Connect lets one device control playback on another compatible device. Put both devices on the same Wi-Fi when setting up, start playing content, select the device icon, and choose the target device. Update both devices and restart them if the target does not appear.

entries.title: Private listening
questions: How do I start a private session?
Can followers see what I play?
entries.answer: Use the Privacy and social settings in the Spotify app to start a Private Session. A private session limits sharing of listening activity and ends automatically after a period of inactivity or when the app restarts, so enable it again when needed.

entries.title: Personal data and privacy controls
questions: How do I request my Spotify data?
How do I change privacy choices?
entries.answer: Spotify processes account, usage, technical, payment and support data to provide and secure the service, personalize features, process payments and meet legal obligations. Available access, deletion, correction and advertising controls are described in the Privacy Policy and Safety and Privacy Center.

entries.title: Podcasts and Spotify for Creators
questions: How do I publish a podcast?
Where can podcast creators get help?
entries.answer: Podcast and show owners should use Spotify for Creators to manage distribution, episodes, analytics and creator support. Listener podcast controls and subscriptions are available in the Spotify app, while creator-specific issues belong in the Spotify for Creators help center.

entries.title: Spotify for Artists
questions: How do artists manage Spotify profiles?
How do I upload music to Spotify?
entries.answer: Artists and their teams use Spotify for Artists to claim profiles, manage images and biographies, pitch music and view audience analytics. Music is delivered to Spotify through a distributor; Spotify for Artists does not directly upload audio releases.

entries.title: Audiobooks and listening hours
questions: Can I buy more audiobook time?
entries.answer: Audiobook access, included monthly listening time and top-ups depend on plan and market. For Family and Duo, included listening time is generally assigned to the plan manager; eligible members may use an Audiobooks+ add-on or purchased time where offered. Check the account plan page for current eligibility.

entries.title: Spotify Premium prices
questions: What is the price of Spotify?
How much does Spotify Premium cost?
What are the Premium plan prices?
entries.answer: Spotify Premium prices depend on your country or region and the plan you choose, such as Individual, Student, Duo or Family. Visit spotify.com/premium to see the current plans, local prices, taxes and any eligible trial offers for your market before subscribing.

entries.title: Subscribe to Spotify Premium
questions: How can I get Spotify Premium?
Where do I sign up for Premium?
I want to buy a Spotify subscription
entries.answer: Go to spotify.com/premium, choose an available Premium plan, sign in or create a Spotify account, and follow the checkout steps for a supported payment method. Available plans, prices, trials and payment methods depend on your country or region. If Premium is billed through a partner, manage it through that provider.

entries.title: What Spotify is
questions: What can I do with Spotify?
Tell me basic information about Spotify
entries.answer: Spotify is a digital service for music, podcasts and audiobooks. You can search for content, follow creators, build a library, make and share playlists, and listen across supported phones, computers, speakers, TVs, cars and other devices. Features vary by plan, device and market.

entries.title: Create a Spotify account
questions: How do I create a Spotify account?
Can I join Spotify for free?
entries.answer: Open spotify.com/signup or the Spotify app, then register with an available method such as email, phone, Google or Apple. Spotify Free does not require a paid subscription. After creating the account, you can choose Premium separately if you want paid features.

entries.title: Search for music, podcasts and audiobooks
questions: How do I search on Spotify?
How can I find a song?
entries.answer: Open Search in the Spotify app and enter an artist, song, album, playlist, podcast, show, episode or audiobook. You can browse categories and filter results where available. If content is missing, its availability may depend on the rights holder and your market.

entries.title: Contact Spotify Support
questions: Can I talk to a person?
entries.answer: Spotify does not currently offer phone support. Use the official Contact us page to message a customer service expert, or search and post in the Spotify Community. Separate help centers are available for artists, creators and authors.
